description: Word, Excel and PowerPoint creation, verified OOXML text edits, engine edits with explicit capability limits, and file conversion.
name: Office Documents

releaseNotes.en: Adds saved paragraph, worksheet and slide-object identities for authorized automatic edits. Expands bounded formula/dependency verification and preserves supported embedded chart workbook formatting. Reopen verification and original-source protection remain required.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 增加已保存段落、工作表与幻灯片对象的精确身份，供授权自动编辑使用；扩展有限公式与依赖验证，并保留支持范围内的嵌入图表工作簿格式。仍须重开校验并保护原文件。
